title: A Multiplicative-Noise Mechanism for Variability Amplification under Radiative Forcing in an Arctic Energy-Balance Model
summary: We propose and analyse a mechanism by which $\mathrm{CO}_2$-driven radiative forcing can increase Arctic temperature variability in a stochastic Sellers-type energy-balance model. Starting from a fast-slow formulation in which insolation is modelled by a rapidly mean-reverting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process while temperature evolves on a slow macroweather timescale, a Wong-Zakai reduction leads to a stochastic energy-balance equation with \emph{multiplicative} noise.
